report.headline: Migration to ML-DSA-87 blocked: bootloader self-update unsupported and critical invariants unverified

main_causes.text: The declared transition requires a bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board (EV-E11-SELF-UPDATE), violating REQ-BOOT-S0S1 for both transition steps.
Critical invariant INV-I2 (transition step S0-S1) is UNKNOWN because no evidence was provided for that step.
Critical invariants INV-I3 and INV-I4 are UNKNOWN due to missing dual-signature policy (GAP-O05-DUAL-POLICY) and missing interruption/atomicity evidence (GAP-E10-INTERRUPT, GAP-E12-NON-ATOMIC).

verified.text: Boot works in both states S0 and S1 (EV-E01-BOOT, EV-E02-BOOT), satisfying INV-I1.
The transitional verifier rejects a factory image with the wrong signing key (EV-E03-PANIC), satisfying REQ-AUTH-NEGATIVE.
The signed factory image (12,876 bytes) fits the boot partition capacity (262,144 bytes), satisfying REQ-LAYOUT.
The image header size is declared and measured as 12,288 bytes (EV-E04-HEADER, EV-E04-HEADER-SPAN).
An application update script is present (EV-APP-UPDATE-SCRIPT).

unknowns.text: RAM/stack usage within budget is UNKNOWN because stack painting was not run (GAP-E07-RAM).
The dual-signature (AND/OR) policy is UNKNOWN because the dual build failed (EV-T3-DUAL-BUILD, GAP-O05-DUAL-POLICY).
Interruption behavior is UNKNOWN: no event-based interruption test (GAP-E10-INTERRUPT) and no non-atomic update window observation (GAP-E12-NON-ATOMIC).
The transition step S0-S1 is UNKNOWN for INV-I2 because no evidence was provided.

report.executive_summary: The migration from ECDSA P-256 to ML-DSA-87 is INCOMPATIBLE because the declared transition requires a bootloader self-update, which is unsupported on this board (EV-E11-SELF-UPDATE), violating REQ-BOOT-S0S1. The candidate itself is INDETERMINATE because critical invariants INV-I2, INV-I3, and INV-I4 remain UNKNOWN: no evidence for the S0-S1 step, the dual-signature build failed (EV-T3-DUAL-BUILD), and interruption/atomicity tests are missing (GAP-E10-INTERRUPT, GAP-E12-NON-ATOMIC). Verified aspects include successful boot in S0/S1 (EV-E01-BOOT, EV-E02-BOOT), rejection of wrong-key images (EV-E03-PANIC), and layout fit (EV-E05-LAYOUT-G2, EV-LAYOUT-PARTITION). RAM usage remains unverified (GAP-E07-RAM).

The field-service reflash plan replaces the bootloader via the debug port during a maintenance window, avoiding the unsupported self-update path.
